title: Wizardsbane Oil

sources.title: Coatings
markers: other coatings simply have no effect

summary: Coating that weakens spell attacks, spell DC and Concentration.

fields.Coat: Single-use Bonus Action. Coat the active weapon for 10 turns. Targets struck take −3 to spell attacks and spell save DC and Disadvantage on Concentration saves for 2 turns. Wild Shape can use the oil, but its attacks do not apply the effect. The selected main-hand and off-hand weapons share the coating. The melee and ranged sets are applied separately. Dipping replaces a coating.
fields.Throw: The item can be thrown, but the item effect and shared coating table document no splash mechanic.
fields.Crafting: Combine Essence of Gremishka Tail with any Suspension. Extract 3 Gremishka Tails for one Essence.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
